$comment: Every shadcn/ui component and what Keyframery does with it. One source for the coverage page, the component pages and what AI tools read. how: automatic (with <Cuts />), helper (wrap your markup), add-on (@keyframery/icon-moves), own (the component's own motion), still (nothing changes on screen).

components.name: Accordion
components.summary: Sections expand and collapse on your theme's curve, and the chevron turns instead of being swapped.
moves: The height eases open and closed
Turns a half turn with the section

components.name: Alert
components.summary: An alert that appears after the page has loaded eases in instead of popping.
components.note: Only an alert inserted on its own eases in; alerts that arrive as part of a whole new page don't. To fold one away when it's dismissed, wrap the area in StateCut.

components.name: Alert Dialog
components.summary: Opens out of the button you pressed and closes back into it; its icon redraws as it arrives.
moves: Rack focus from the button that opened it
Redraws once as the dialog lands

components.name: Aspect Ratio
components.summary: Nothing changes on screen, so nothing moves.

components.name: Attachment
components.summary: Attachments ease in when added; a finished upload gives a small punch and a failed one shakes.
moves: The thumbnail gives a small punch
components.note: Removing an attachment from a list folds it away with ListCut.

components.name: Avatar
components.summary: When the photo finishes loading, it dissolves in over the fallback initials.

components.name: Badge
components.summary: A count in a badge rolls to its new value instead of flickering.
moves: Changed digits roll, with a small punch

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.summary: A breadcrumb changes with the route; route-to-route transitions are outside shadcn, so it stays as it is.
components.note: Transitions between your own routes are on the roadmap.

components.name: Bubble
components.summary: A new message bubble arrives from where it was sent instead of appearing at the bottom.
moves: Flies from the composer, or slides in

components.name: Button
components.summary: A button dips while it's pressed, quicker in than out; with Icon moves, its icon plays its own move.
moves: Dips to 97%, keeping shadcn's 1 px nudge
Plays its own move (a gear turns, a bell rings)

components.name: Button Group
components.summary: Each button in the group dips while it's pressed.

components.name: Calendar
components.summary: The selected day glides to the day you click, and a new month slides in from the side you went toward.
moves: The new month slides in from that side
Dip and nudge toward where they go
components.note: Moving through days or months with the keyboard stays instant.

components.name: Card
components.summary: A card opens into its detail view, on the same page or a new route, and shrinks back when you return.
moves: Match cut: the card grows into the detail

components.name: Carousel
components.summary: The arrows dip and nudge while pressed; the slides keep Embla's own motion.
moves: Dips and nudges 2 px toward its direction

components.name: Chart
components.summary: Recharts animates its own data, so Keyframery leaves it alone.

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: The tick draws itself when you check it; boxes that load checked don't redraw.

components.name: Collapsible
components.summary: Shadcn's collapsible has no motion of its own; with Keyframery it eases open and closed.
moves: The height eases open and closed

components.name: Combobox
components.summary: The list opens from the input on your theme's curve, the chevron turns, and picked items tick.
moves: Grows from the input and returns to it
Turns while the list is open
components.note: Moving the highlight with the arrow keys stays instant.

components.name: Command
components.summary: The command dialog opens with the dialog's cut; checked items tick, and the keyboard highlight stays instant.
components.note: The highlight follows your arrow keys instantly: a command palette is used hundreds of times a day.

components.name: Context Menu
components.summary: Opens from the pointer and closes back into it on your theme's curve; checkbox and radio items tick.
moves: Grows from the pointer and returns to it
A checkbox or radio item is checked
components.note: The highlight follows your pointer and keys instantly.

components.name: Dialog
components.summary: Grows out of the button you pressed and closes back into it.
moves: Rack focus from the button that opened it

components.name: Direction
components.summary: A provider with nothing on screen.

components.name: Drawer
components.summary: The page steps back behind the drawer; the drawer's own swipe motion stays.
moves: The page behind sinks and rounds its corners

components.name: Dropdown Menu
components.summary: Opens from its trigger and closes back into it on your theme's curve; checkbox and radio items tick.
moves: Grows from its trigger and returns to it
A checkbox or radio item is checked
components.note: The highlight follows your pointer and keys instantly.

components.name: Empty
components.summary: An empty state arrives in place of content, and content replaces it, without a jump.
moves: Fade or slide, with the height easing

components.name: Field
components.summary: Choice cards change colour instead of jumping, and an error shakes once and rises in.
moves: It turns invalid after a submit

components.name: Form
components.summary: Form has no markup of its own; its fields respond through Field and Input.

components.name: Hover Card
components.summary: The card opens out of the link you hover and closes back into it, on your theme's curve.
moves: Grows from its trigger and returns to it

components.name: Input
components.summary: An input that turns invalid after a submit gives one short shake; never while you type.
moves: It turns invalid after a submit or blur

components.name: Input Group
components.summary: The whole group shakes once when its input turns invalid after a submit.
moves: Its input turns invalid after a submit

components.name: Input OTP
components.summary: An invalid code shakes once; typing stays instant.
components.note: The active slot moves as you type, so it stays instant.

components.name: Item
components.summary: Items are added, removed and reordered without jumping, and an item can open into its detail.

components.name: Kbd
components.summary: A keyboard key label never changes, so nothing moves.

components.name: Label
components.summary: A label never changes, so nothing moves.

components.name: Marker
components.summary: A marker never changes, so nothing moves.

components.name: Menubar
components.summary: Menus open from their trigger and close back into it on your theme's curve; checkbox and radio items tick.
moves: Grows from its trigger and returns to it
A checkbox or radio item is checked
components.note: The highlight follows your pointer and keys instantly.

components.name: Message
components.summary: A new message arrives from where it was sent.
moves: Flies from the composer, or slides in

components.name: Message Scroller
components.summary: Keeps its own scroll motion; new messages arrive through ListCut, and the jump button dips and nudges.
moves: Dips and nudges toward the end

components.name: Native Select
components.summary: An invalid choice shakes once; the popup is drawn by the browser and can't be animated.
moves: It turns invalid after a submit

components.name: Navigation Menu
components.summary: Keeps its own direction-aware motion and follows your theme's timing.
moves: Opens, closes or moves between items
Its own direction-aware motion, on your theme's timing

components.name: Pagination
components.summary: The current page glides to the one you click, and the links dip while pressed.
moves: Dips; previous and next nudge toward their side

components.name: Popover
components.summary: A popover grows out of the button that opened it and goes back into it, on your theme's curve.
moves: Grows from its trigger and returns to it

components.name: Progress
components.summary: The bar eases to its new value on your theme's curve.

components.name: Questionnaire
components.summary: Picked choices tick or grow their dot, and the next step slides in like a tab.
moves: The tick draws itself, or the dot grows
The new step slides in from that side

components.name: Radio Group
components.summary: The dot grows from its centre on the item you pick.
moves: Its dot grows from the centre

components.name: Resizable
components.summary: The handle thickens and takes the focus colour while you drag it.
moves: Thickens and takes the focus colour

components.name: Scroll Area
components.summary: Scrolling follows your finger and wheel, so Keyframery adds nothing.

components.name: Select
components.summary: The list opens out of its trigger and closes back into it on your theme's curve, while the highlight follows your keys instantly.
moves: Grows from its trigger and returns to it
components.note: The highlight follows your pointer and keys instantly.

components.name: Separator
components.summary: A separator never changes, so nothing moves.

components.name: Sheet
components.summary: Slides in from its edge while the page steps back, and its ✕ turns while pressed.
moves: Slides from its edge; the page behind sinks

components.name: Sidebar
components.summary: The active item glides to the one you pick, the width follows your theme's curve, and labels leave before it closes.
moves: Width on your curve; labels leave first and arrive last

components.name: Skeleton
components.summary: A skeleton dissolves into the real content, and never shows at all if the data is quick.
moves: Dissolve; no skeleton if it takes under 300 ms

components.name: Slider
components.summary: The thumb grows while you drag it and settles on release; arrow keys stay instant.

components.name: Sonner
components.summary: A toast flies from the button that made it, and its status icon plays as it lands.
moves: Cut on action: from the button you pressed
A tick or cross draws itself, a warning rocks

components.name: Spinner
components.summary: A spinner already spins, so Keyframery leaves it alone.

components.name: Switch
components.summary: The thumb travels on your theme's curve and stretches toward where it's going while held.
moves: The thumb travels on your curve
The thumb stretches toward its other side

components.name: Table
components.summary: Rows are added, removed and reordered without jumping.
moves: Rows are added, removed or moved

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: The indicator moves first and the new panel follows a beat later, while the height eases to fit.
moves: J-cut: the pill leads, the panel follows

components.name: Textarea
components.summary: A textarea that turns invalid after a submit gives one short shake; never while you type.
moves: It turns invalid after a submit or blur

components.name: Toast
components.summary: A toast flies from the button that made it, its status icon plays as it lands, and its ✕ turns while pressed.
moves: Cut on action: from the button you pressed
A tick or cross draws itself, a warning rocks

components.name: Toggle
components.summary: A toggle dips while pressed; with Icon moves, its icon plays its own move.

components.name: Toggle Group
components.summary: Items dip while pressed, and a single choice glides to the item you pick.
components.note: A selection moved with the arrow keys stays instant.

components.name: Tooltip
components.summary: Opens from its trigger on your theme's curve; once one is open, neighbours open instantly.
moves: Grows from its trigger and returns to it
